whatIs: Magnific is the new name of Freepik: the same bank of visual resources (photos, vectors, illustrations, icons, templates and mockups), now alongside AI tools to generate and edit images, video and audio, plus its image and video upscalers.
It's a good fit when you need stock graphics for a website or a campaign and also want to generate or retouch images in the same place.
uses: Finding a stock illustration or photo for a landing page cover.
Downloading an editable mockup to present an app's design.
Generating or upscaling an image with AI when you can't find exactly what you're looking for in the stock library.
caveats: Free content requires attribution; using it without giving credit and accessing Premium content require a paid plan.
The AI tools run on credits, and each plan comes with a different annual amount.
The terms don't allow using stock content, in whole or in part, within a logo or brand, unless you modify it substantially.
pricingNote: There's free content with attribution; plans start at $11 a month with annual payment ($16 monthly) and go up to Plus and Pro.
idealFor: Teams that need stock resources and AI generation in a single subscription.
